preserved_corrections.correction: read journal mode first and set WAL only during database creation

preserved_corrections.finding: the target mount for the first transient bootstrap denied execution
preserved_corrections.correction: use the exact authorized CyberBoss state directory for the transient bootstrap

preserved_corrections.correction: bind acceptance discovery to the commit-bound database filename and amend the unpublished implementation commit

preserved_corrections.finding: four unmanifested macOS metadata files accompanied the required three artifacts
preserved_corrections.correction: disable metadata generation and transfer exactly the three named artifact files

preserved_corrections.finding: the verification command was malformed by local shell quoting
preserved_corrections.correction: use corrected quoting and independently verify the three-file inventory and checksums

preserved_corrections.finding: the audit awk command line matched its own CyberBoss process pattern and produced a count of one
preserved_corrections.correction: exclude the audit process from the read-only process filter and rerun the complete target-state check
